req_spec.title: Priority, status transitions and task summaries
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-004, TF-REQ-005, TF-REQ-016 and TF-REQ-017. Code-derived acceptance detail is cited to validation.js, TaskCard.jsx, SummaryCards.jsx and App.jsx. No separate customer SRS exists.

requirement.title: Priority values and validation
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-004 specifies Low, Medium and High. src/utils/validation.js PRIORITIES and validateTask accept exactly those case-sensitive strings; an invalid value returns "Please select a valid priority." The native select in src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx offers only the three valid options.

requirement.title: Status values and validation
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-005 specifies To Do, In Progress and Completed. src/utils/validation.js STATUSES and validateTask accept exactly those case-sensitive strings; an invalid value returns "Please select a valid status." The native selects in src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx and src/components/TaskCard.jsx offer only those options.

requirement.title: Status change and summary totals
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-016 requires status updates and status counts; Behaviour notes require summary cards to count all tasks regardless of search and filters. src/App.jsx changeStatus ignores unsupported values, persists an accepted status change and shows "Task status updated." src/components/SummaryCards.jsx counts tasks and each status from the complete tasks array.

requirement.title: Completed task presentation
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-017 gives Completed its own count and exempts it from overdue treatment. src/components/TaskCard.jsx adds class "completed" for Completed tasks, uses isOverdue for the Overdue badge/red date, and suppresses the Due today badge for Completed tasks; src/utils/dates.js isOverdue excludes status Completed.

req_spec.title: Due dates, local calendar rules and formatting
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-006 plus its Behaviour notes on overdue dates. Code-derived acceptance detail is cited to dates.js, validation.js, TaskFormModal.jsx, TaskCard.jsx and TopBar.jsx. No separate customer SRS exists.

requirement.title: Optional due date and real calendar validation
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-006 allows an optional due date stored as YYYY-MM-DD and Exact messages states "Please enter a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD)." for an invalid real date. src/utils/validation.js validateTask accepts undefined, null and empty string as absent and rejects any other value that is not a real calendar date per src/utils/dates.js isValidDateString. src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx uses a native input type=date, which sanitizes impossible values before application validation.

requirement.title: Leap years and calendar boundaries
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-006 requires a due date and the source date format is YYYY-MM-DD. src/utils/dates.js isValidDateString requires the exact four-two-two digit format, month 1-12, day >=1, month-specific maximum days and Gregorian leap-year rule (divisible by 4 except centuries unless divisible by 400). No separate application minimum/maximum year or due-date range is documented.

requirement.title: Overdue and due-today decision
requirement.description: README.md Behaviour notes define overdue as due date earlier than today (local date) AND status not Completed; today is not overdue and displays "Due today" for non-Completed tasks. src/utils/dates.js isOverdue and todayString implement the rule; src/components/TaskCard.jsx displays "Overdue" or "Due today" and colors overdue dates.

requirement.title: Local calendar day and date display
requirement.description: README.md TF-REQ-006 and Behaviour notes define due dates as local calendar days. src/utils/dates.js todayString uses local year/month/day, formatDueDate formats a YYYY-MM-DD value with en-US short month/day/year, and formatToday formats the supplied local Date as a weekday and full date. src/components/TaskCard.jsx renders "Due: <formatted date>" and src/components/TopBar.jsx renders the formatted current day.
